Caption / description / post text:
WINTER COMFORTS EP. 1 🍝😍🥩  Short Rib Ragu!  One of my favourite things to make and eat in the colder months. So rich and never fails to please everyone around the table Ingredients: Serves 3-4: - 1.2-1.5kg short ribs - 1 white onion, diced - 1 large carrot, diced - 2 sticks celery, diced - 4 cloves garlic, diced - Fresh thyme, rosemary, bay leaves - Parmesan rind - 1 tbsp tomato puree - 1 tin chopped tomatoes (@mutti) - 300ml red wine (cab sav works well) - 500ml beef stock - 300-400g pappardelle - EV olive oil - Parmesan, finely grated  Method: 1. Start by seasoning your short ribs with salt and pepper, then searing on medium-high heat with some olive oil in a Dutch oven. You want deep caramelisation on all sides, set aside but leave fat in the pot 2. Bring temp down to medium and throw in your onion, carrot, celery, garlic and soften for 3-4 minutes 3. Add your tomato puree and cook out for 2 minutes. Then deglaze with your red wine and cook alcohol out, 5-6 minutes 4. Add back your short ribs and cover with beef stock. Throw in your thyme, rosemary, bay and parmesan rind 5. Put the lid on and braise in a 140C oven for 4 hours 6. Remove short ribs from the pot. They should fall off the bone. Shred on a tray 7. Before adding your beef back to the pot remove the thyme, rosemary, bay leaves and parmesan rind. Then add your beef and simmer for 10 minutes to get it nicely incorporated 8. Whilst the beef is simmering, boil your pasta 2 minutes less than the pasta says. 9. Add to a pan on medium-low with some of your ragu and finish cooking the pasta. Mix well with pasta water and parmesan to create a silky sauce 10. Plate your pasta and top with more ragu, parmesan and some fresh parsley! #pasta #easyrecipes #homecooking #recipe #food 

Transcript of the video's audio (machine-made):
Welcome back to Winter Comforts, the series where I show you how to make some classic winter dishes that are perfect for the colder months. Today we're making a short rib ragu with papadella. When it's a bit chilly outside this is the first thing I run to and it's easy to make but it just takes a bit of time. So to start you want to get yourself some short ribs and get them nicely seasoned with some salt and pepper. Then get these seared off in a high heat with some oil till you get a deep brown colour on them like this. Set these to the side then dice onion, carrot, celery and garlic. Get this nicely softened in the pot the beef was in before cooking out some tomato puree. Then deglaze with a nice red wine and cut the alcohol out before going in with a tin of chopped tomatoes. Wipe your short ribs back in and then cover with beef stock and throw in your fresh herbs and a parmesan run. Get it in the oven for 4 hours then you're left with these extremely tender and juicy short ribs. Shred it up and then throw it straight back into the sauce. Then simply spoon in some of your ragu into a pan and then whack in your pasta. Mix with pasta water and parmesan till it almost fuzz into a silky sauce.
